     retry worker.
  3. Orders, Refunds and Payouts read those rows. A redelivery then stops
     double-counting, at no cost, for every consumer.
  4. Nothing to change in the client, and the signing policy stays as it is.

  One thing to flag for the audit log, without planning it: an auditor needs
  entries the service cannot rewrite afterwards. I would route every write
  through a single append-only function now, so that can be tightened later
  without restructuring.

  Optional add-on: a dedupe window of 30–60 seconds for events that arrive twice
  in a row. It is one config line but an experimental flag, so your call.

  Decision for you: go with the slim stored-events version as P3.5, and do you
  want the dedupe add-on?

  Sources:
  - Webhook best practices — Example docs (https://example.com/docs/webhooks)
  - Retry schedules (https://example.com/docs/retries)
  - Idempotency keys — Example docs
    (https://example.com/docs/idempotency)
